en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I was worried about Miu and her
"augmented" story, so I went to talk to her.

<CLT=cltMIND>She seems down...
She must be thinking hard about something.
Ah, Miu?
Wh-What? Don't talk down to me.
N-No, I'm worried about you...

W-W-W-W-Worried!?
You're worried about me!?
<CLT=cltMIND>Her voice cracked...

I...I-I'm fine.
I'm not that upset.

But you were talking about
being augmented before...

S-So what? Even if I am human, it's not
your problem.

I suppose you're right...
To me, you're still Miu.

Nghhh...
H-How can you say that?

Miu? Your face is red,
is something wrong?

Hngh!? N-Nothing's wrong!
Boy, is it hot! Aren't you hot!? I'm hot!

I guess I gotta take off my clothes now!
Isn't that right!? Okay, off they go!
What!? W-Wait!
Hmph! I'm lettin' it all hang out!
S-Stop!

Th-Then you...take it off...
Take off your clothes...
Why!?

C'mon, just whip it out already!
Jerk it to my perfect proportions!

What are you talking about!?
And hey, hands off!

Ughhh... Ughhhhhhhhh...
Ughhhhhhhhhhh...
Are you sick?
You should get some rest
Are you worried about something?
Are you unsure of something?
Miu, what's wrong?

Are you sick? You've been acting
weird, perhaps a fever...?

F-Fever!? N-No way!
I don't have a fever! Nuh-uh!
But your face is so red...

Wh-Wh-What the hell!? You sayin' I'm lovesick
or somethin'!? Man, you're annoying!

You should get some rest.
You're clearly not feeling well.

Huh...? D-Don't spring that on me
all of a sudden...
What do you mean?

C-Cuz, I mean, y'know...we should at least
go on a date before we hit the sheets...
Are you worried about something?

Huhhhhhhh? Shuichi, you blockhead! What
does a genius like me need to worry about!?
...W-Would it be weird if I was worried, though?

It wouldn't be weird at all, Miu.
Even geniuses worry about things.
B-But it's just heartache...
What?

Ahhhhh! I mean...!
Wh-Wh-What I meant was...ahhhhhh!
A heartache... I see, so that's what's wrong.
Y-Y-Yeah! I'm fallin' for you!
What!? Me!?

You said it first. That you're so worried about
me...cuz you're in love with me.
...I never said that!
...Huh? You didn't?
No, I didn't!

Ah, ah, ah...
AHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu's face somehow got even redder
and she ran off, wailing.

<CLT=cltMIND>Did Miu...just confess her
love to me...?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Miu's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu was long gone.
I returned to my room, dumbfounded.

<CLT=cltMIND>What should I say when
I see her again?
